facts.fact: Fletcher 冲进办公室报「她来了」——Caroline 又出现在 Zane 的办公室
facts.anchor: Fletcher appeared, his eye shining with excitement.

facts.fact: 管家 Fletcher 固执得很，擅自替主人答应：Caroline 点名要见他，他告诉她主人会陪她喝茶
facts.anchor: Obstinate to a fault, he walked in and closed the door behind him.

facts.fact: 时间线：Zane 整整消失了一个星期，其间 Caroline 发现了他在暗中监视她；昨天他才拿离婚文件在公园追上她
facts.anchor: You disappeared for a week, and during that time she discovered your spying on her.

facts.fact: Orson 被诱到怀俄明州夏延郊外——Zane 上一趟西部行程就是为找他
facts.anchor: He is in Wyoming, just outside

facts.fact: 是 Zane 自掏腰包组织了这场为期六周的狩猎，只为让 Caroline 离开丈夫几天喘口气
facts.anchor: I organized the hunting trip to lure Orson out of the city.

facts.fact: Caroline 今天一早就把离婚文件递交到市政厅，离婚已不可撤销
